title: The War of the Shifting Sands
summary: The night elves, qiraji, and dragonflights fight a war that ends with Ahn'Qiraj sealed behind the Scarab Wall.
opening: Long before the gates were opened again, the war in Silithus drove its defenders toward a decision they could not mistake for victory.

chapters.title: War across Silithus
chapters.body: Follow Fandral Staghelm's night elf forces against the qiraji and silithid, keeping the campaign's movements broad where the source does not give surveyed routes.

chapters.title: The dragons answer
chapters.body: Anachronos and the dragonflights enter the defense. Review the short story's perspective to distinguish what its narrator recalls from a neutral account of every battlefield.

chapters.title: The cost to Fandral
chapters.body: Valstann's death brings the war's personal cost into focus. Trace how this loss affects Fandral's response to the dragons and to the proposed seal.

chapters.title: The Scarab Wall
chapters.body: The defenders contain Ahn'Qiraj behind a barrier and leave a scepter able to open it. Fandral's breaking of that key carries the war's unresolved danger into a later age.

reviewNote: Keep this ancient war separate from the Era 8 Scepter questline. Check chronology and the short story's narrative perspective before publishing a full account.
